results.title: Karnataka faces -32% rainfall deficit as Bengaluru South sees -87% shortage
results.article: The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** reported that **Karnataka** received 564.6 mm rainfall against a normal 831.8 mm, a -32% deficit. The **Bengaluru** city station recorded 313 mm with a -236 mm departure, while the **HAL** station received 434 mm. **C.S Patil** attributed these deficits to strong El Nino. **Bengaluru South** saw an -87% deficit, while **Coastal Karnataka**, **North Interior Karnataka**, and **South Interior Karnataka** also faced significant rainfall shortages.

results.title: India, US Trade Deal Faces US Tariff Hurdles; Goyal Heads to Talks
results.article: Foreign Minister **S Jaishankar** said the India-US trade agreement, if concluded, would improve bilateral ties despite prolonged negotiations due to complex realities. Both sides have reached an understanding but face issues related to US tariff policies and the Section 301 process. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal will visit the US for further discussions. Jaishankar spoke at an Asia Society event in New York during the UN General Assembly session.

results.title: Election Commission Faces 8,14,160 Pending Applications, 6,49,085 Stuck Over 45 Days
results.article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** has received 8,38,558 application forms as part of the Claims & Objections phase ending October 7. Of these, 4,43,705 are for fresh enrolment via Form-6 and 3,57,898 for corrections via Form-8; deletions (Form-7) total 30,676, while 6,279 pertain to Non Resident Indians. Hyderabad district leads with 3,04,354 applications. Processing lags, leaving 8,14,160 applications pending, including 6,49,085 for over 45 days. Additionally, 4,90,600 notices remain undelivered by the November 5 deadline.

results.title: DDX39A Protein Unwinds Viral RNA, Slows Parkinson’s-Linked Clumps
results.article: Scientists at the **CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB)**, led by Swasti Raychaudhuri, discovered that RNA viruses like influenza and SARS-CoV-2 can trigger molecular changes linked to Parkinson’s disease by accelerating alpha-synuclein aggregation. However, a protein called DDX39A moves into the cytoplasm during infection, unwinding viral RNA structures and slowing harmful protein clump formation. Published September 29, 2026.

results.title: Sikkim Official Recommends Declaring Rimbi Village Uninhabitable After Landslides
results.article: After a series of landslides and flash floods triggered by intense monsoon rainfall, **Rinzing Chewang**, Sikkim Disaster Relief Commissioner, surveyed Rimbi village on September 25 and recommended declaring it 'uninhabitable'. At least 32 houses and 4 government quarters were damaged since August 13. Residents have been moved to relief camps; families with completely damaged homes will receive Rs 1.3 lakh in compensation under the Sikkim Housing Scheme, which also provides land and housing support for those who lost their property. Chief Minister **Prem Singh Tamang** prioritized public safety by issuing directions to authorities to remain on high alert.
